task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the conditional 'if you move the ball, you must also take the key' is captured by RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) (a no-timing cue, correct template; though implied by the other clauses, it is stated by the task so it stays). 'Then pick up the box' gives Existence(target_picked_up) hard, Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up), and Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up), matching the documented Then-chain pattern. Priorities are hard as worded, propositions are declared, and no clause is added beyond the task.

Take the key before picking up the target box.
Whenever the ball has been moved, pick up the target box at or after that step.
